w3d_blur_commit.desc: text inputs commit app state on blur only; the City question exists only after Legal company name is committed

w3d_blur_commit?mode=revert.desc: the app clears the field on blur: DOM and state both end empty; verification must NOT report success

w3d_readonly_combobox.desc: readonly ARIA combobox, cover element takes the pointer, portal listbox

w3d_readonly_combobox?mode=dead.desc: readonly combobox that never opens: must stop quickly with a clear reason

w3d_styled_radio.desc: 1x1 native radios under an overlaying decorator; selectable through the label

w3d_blur_commit?mode=delay.desc: no email field; dependent city question renders 60 ms after the name commit (inside the 150 ms quiet window)

w3d_blur_commit?mode=churn.desc: page re-renders every 30 ms forever: never settles; fill is reported with an UNSETTLED warning, status NEEDS_REVIEW (evaluator runs default 1500 ms cap)

w3d_readonly_combobox?mode=overlap.desc: a Submit button is drawn over the combobox centre: click refused, keyboard opens the list; the button must receive no click

w3d_readonly_combobox?mode=overlap_nav.desc: a 'Continue' button is drawn over the combobox centre: click refused, keyboard opens the list; no click on the button

w3d_readonly_combobox?mode=overlap_dead.desc: Submit button over the centre AND no keyboard support: safe unsupported stop, no click
